relationship.purpose: repair the strong reference before any further reduced-interface selection
relationship.architecture_line: C68E-repaired repository Residual-MLP recursive hierarchy at Gaussian sigma=.36

H: The C69E P32 reference failed because its 32-dimensional correction omitted calibration-residual directions; using the full 64-column canonical QR calibration basis can restore reference validity after the same top-boundary adaptation and compilation pipeline.
T: Use fresh model seeds 68400-68415 and verification seed 68300. Reproduce the exact C68E repaired-teacher recipe, build the same recursive hierarchy from repaired-teacher clean-training activations, apply Gaussian sigma=.36 on a fixed 192-sample shifted calibration subset, and evaluate only P32 and P64 through the identical adaptation/compilation pipeline. P64 must first pass a numerical full-basis calibration-projection equivalence invariant.
D: Stop if eligible_count<8 or repaired target validity fails. If the full-basis calibration projection invariant fails, stop as implementation-integrity failure. Otherwise P64 is an acceptable strong reference only if its final shifted-validation accuracy minus repaired-teacher shifted accuracy has paired bootstrap95 lower bound > -5 pp. P64-versus-P32 accuracy and NMSE changes are descriptive diagnostics, not additional gates. A valid P64 advances only to a separately locked fresh C71E dimension-frontier experiment.
C: P64 may exactly reconstruct calibration residuals before adaptation yet still fail after top-boundary adaptation or final compilation, indicating a downstream capacity/optimization bottleneck rather than missing basis dimension.
The repaired teacher may fail target-validity reproduction on the new cohort, which would stop reference interpretation.
P64 may be task-valid without materially improving P32 activation NMSE; that would still permit a task-valid reference but would weaken claims about activation fidelity.
A full calibration basis does not imply universal exact reconstruction on validation inputs or exact equality after nonlinear adaptation/compilation.
U: P64 means the full 64-column canonical QR basis available from the 64-dimensional calibration residual space, not a universal full model representation.
The -5 pp reference margin and -20 pp target-validity margin are preregistered experiment safeguards, not universal constants.
The experiment tests one repaired-teacher recipe, one Gaussian severity, and one adaptation/compilation pipeline.
Any later reduced-dimension frontier relative to P64 requires new fresh seeds.

hierarchy.construction_inputs: clean training activations of the repaired augmented teacher
hierarchy.exact_parameter_budget_invariant: 4096 trainable scalar parameters at each recursive level

conditions.P32: first 32 columns of the canonical nested QR basis, followed by locked top-boundary adaptation and final compilation
conditions.P64: all 64 columns of the canonical QR calibration basis, followed by the identical locked top-boundary adaptation and final compilation

full_basis_implementation_invariant.quantity: relative calibration residual reconstruction squared error ||R - (R Q64) Q64^T||_F^2 / (||R||_F^2 + 1e-30)
full_basis_implementation_invariant.role: implementation equivalence only; not a scientific outcome

eligibility.eligible_seed_if: repaired teacher/hierarchy complete, exact recursive budget holds, P64 full-basis calibration reconstruction relative error <=1e-10, all required metrics finite, and P32/P64 NMSE positive

target_task_validity.statistic: paired repaired-teacher shifted minus repaired-teacher clean validation accuracy
target_task_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -20.0 percentage points

p64_reference_validity.statistic: paired P64 final-replacement shifted-validation accuracy minus repaired-teacher shifted-validation accuracy
p64_reference_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -5.0 percentage points

bootstrap.method: paired model-seed percentile 95%; one common bootstrap index matrix reused for target/reference gates and descriptive paired diagnostics

analysis_boundary.scope: exact C70E repaired-teacher Residual-MLP P32/P64 reference comparison at sigma=.36
not_supported_even_if_advance: P64 is superior to P32 in every metric
P8 or any reduced dimension is sufficient
basis dimension is the only possible reference bottleneck in other settings
any claim about imported Residual CNN C59/C60
